title: Mays Welcome Event
description: Join us for the Mays Welcome Event Friday, August 21 from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. during Howdy Week. This event is designed to welcome new students, including freshmen and transfer students, to the Mays community. Stop by to enjoy free food and giveaways, explore the Business Student Council Mays Exchange, and connect with a variety of Mays-wide resources. Representatives from undergraduate and graduate programs, as well as key offices and centers, will be available at the resource table fair to answer questions and help you get started on the right track.

title: English Language Proficiency Practice Group for Instructors August Intensive 2026 (Session 1): Overview and Introductions
description:
Facilitator: Ginessa Payne, Center for Teaching Excellence

Description: First in a series of workshops for graduate students, post-docs, and visiting scholars whose primary language is not English. This interactive workshop introduces the series and key features of American English pronunciation (intonation).

It encourages instructors to make a positive first impression on their students with a self-introduction speech on the first day of class.

Learning Outcomes: Participants will be able to…

1. Develop a self-introduction that conveys your knowledge, approachability, and passion for your subject, using effective volume, rate, and poise.
